purpose: single-factor removal/isolation of five frozen admission/selection modules; no parameter search

common_contract.universe: authorized frozen daily ChinNext PIT-B membership with listed_trading_days >= 180
common_contract.execution: completed-close signal; next-session open; T+1/tradability/limit checks unchanged
common_contract.market_exits: 399102 MA20 x2 and emergency Close < MA20*0.96 unchanged in every arm

A1_MINUS_MINVOL.single_change: disable the entire MINVOL hard admission filter

A2_MINUS_B60.single_change: remove only strict signal Close > previous-60-close high admission

A3_MINUS_FULL40.single_change: disable the entire FULL40 admission module

A4_NO_RS_SELECTION_CONTROL.single_change: replace RS vacancy priority only with deterministic SHA256 ascending priority

A5_MINUS_MARKET_ENTRY_GATE.single_change: remove market entry permission blocking for NEW ENTRIES only; all market exits remain active

metric_contract.trade: completed position cycle from frozen accounting semantics
metric_contract.pnl_concentration_denominator: sum of positive completed-cycle realized PnL
metric_contract.return_ex_best_n: arm total return minus top-N completed-cycle PnL / frozen initial cash; ending marked positions unchanged
metric_contract.winner_capture: exact same (normalized_symbol, entry_signal_date) episode; same symbol at another date is reported separately and is not captured
metric_contract.arm_top20: top 20 completed cycles by realized PnL descending with symbol and exit date deterministic tie-break
metric_contract.candidate_event_count: symbol-date events passing every arm-active admission module and present in the eligible RS table, before market entry permission and vacancy selection
metric_contract.selected_entry_count: filled BUY legs whose new_position is true
metric_contract.2024_09_entry_cohort: completed cycles with entry_signal_date from 2024-09-01 through 2024-09-30 inclusive
metric_contract.pnl_excluding_2024_09_entry_cohort: sum of completed-cycle realized PnL outside the fixed cohort
metric_contract.return_excluding_2024_09_entry_cohort: UNRESOLVED unless a cash-flow counterfactual can be reconstructed without a new strategy replay; no proxy portfolio return may be fabricated

comparison_contract.drawdown_delta: arm max_drawdown - A0 max_drawdown; negative means worse drawdown
module_label_rules_in_order: RISK_FILTERING if removal worsens max drawdown by at least 5pp or expands completed trades or average exposure by at least 25%, unless it meets POSSIBLY_HARMFUL
POSSIBLY_HARMFUL if removal improves total return by at least 10pp, does not worsen max drawdown by more than 3pp, and improves return-ex-best20 by at least 10pp
CLEARLY_HELPFUL if removal reduces total return by at least 10pp and also reduces exact baseline-Top20 capture or worsens return-ex-best20
REDUNDANT_IN_THIS_SAMPLE if absolute return delta <5pp, drawdown delta <3pp, Top20 concentration delta <5pp, return-ex-best20 delta <5pp, and exact Top20 capture loss <=2
TRADEOFF if return changes by at least 5pp while drawdown, concentration, exposure, or winner capture moves materially in the opposite direction
comparison_contract.most_helpful_module: removed module whose arm has the most negative return delta, only if another risk/concentration/capture metric also worsens; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
comparison_contract.most_redundant_module: arm satisfying REDUNDANT_IN_THIS_SAMPLE with smallest absolute return delta; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
comparison_contract.largest_risk_control_effect: removed module whose arm has the most negative max-drawdown delta; report INCONCLUSIVE if all absolute deltas <1pp
comparison_contract.largest_winner_capture_effect: removed module with largest loss of exact baseline Top20 episodes; ties use fixed arm order
